product.title: Rome by Night eBike Tour with Pizza Option

description.text: Experience the most beautiful time in Rome when you explore at twilight—and see more sights in one tour than you could on your own—all thanks to this electric bike excursion. With just your guide and small group for company, watch the sunset and pass by major monuments such as the Colosseum, Roman Forum, Pantheon, and Trevi Fountain. Stops include Colosseum, Roman Forum, Pantheon, Trevi Fountain. If you've upgraded when booking, enjoy an authentic Roman pizza afterwards. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Colosseum, Roman Forum, Pantheon, Trevi Fountain that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
